comment: This version has no attenuverters, no CV jacks and no trigger outputs. The menu is shorter than holder's to match: the 'Gate Out instead Trig', 'Trig on start', 'Trig on end' and 'Gate Inversion' items are all commented out at Holder8.cpp:722-737 and do not appear. The menu settings apply to all eight rows at once. The signal jacks carry whatever is patched, so the IN and OUT jacks get no family.
